name: Wild Wild West Con
blurb: Steampunk convention held at the Westward Look Resort in Tucson; its 14th edition in March 2026 was announced as the grand finale.

last.venue: Westward Look Wyndham Grand Resort and Spa

notes: Defunct: WWWC14 (March 19-22, 2026) was announced as the convention's final year. KGUN9 news: 'The Wild Wild West Steampunk Convention marks its 14th and final year at the Westward Look Resort'; Steampunk Explorer also covered it as a 'Grand Finale'. The organizers said they plan smaller-scale events (dinners, workshops, a steampunk ball) instead of continuing the annual convention. The batch note calling WWWC14 'the first 4-day edition' appears to predate this finale announcement.
